description.en: Adult female Mongolarachne jurassica reconstructed from the compressed holotype and revised interpretation. Body depth, colour, eyes, posture, missing leg tips and short palps are inferred; fine plumose setae are simplified. Relationships and web architecture remain uncertain, without implying modern Nephila identity or golden silk.
description.zh: Mongolarachne jurassica 成体雌蛛参考压扁模式化石及修订解释复原。体厚、颜色、眼、姿态、缺失足端与短触肢为推定，细小羽状刚毛已简化。亲缘及网结构仍不确定，不暗示现生 Nephila 身份或金色蛛丝。

construction_notes: Model body masses with deliberate tapered profiles and custom cross sections; use a softly faceted abdomen, a lower carapace and narrow rounded limb sections.
Make the eight leg paths individually readable in top and perspective views. Avoid crossing left/right leg bundles and intersections with the abdomen.
A neutral balanced display stance is a staging convention, not a claim that this spider was a ground runner. A restrained roughly bilateral stance is preferred to copying the fossil death pose.
Keep setal clumps subordinate to joint structure. Combine appropriate setal geometry per semantic limb for export efficiency rather than creating a draw call for each hair.
Preserve fixed budgets; spend geometry on limb articulation, body taper and visible bristle silhouettes rather than microscopic barbs.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Body size follows the female fossil approximately; the pedicel, three-dimensional depth, height and projected leg span are design estimates, not a measured living envelope.

factual_checks.criterion: Public labeling names the female-based living reconstruction, not Nephila as current identity or an exact fossil cast.
Carapace and abdomen keep the frozen footprint ratios and an oval, not spherical, abdomen.
Eight walking legs preserve the 1243 length order and clearly shortened third pair; missing IV segments stay labeled inferred.
No transplantation of elongated male palps; all-pair tibial gaiters remain readable.
No golden-web, resolved-family-affinity or doctored chaoyangensis anatomy is asserted.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-GLB front/side/top/perspective images. Perspective may reuse preview bytes. Source/export audit, Khronos validation, exact-GLB loader check, two isolated semantic rebuilds and fresh independent visual/specification review remain required. GPU, populated-scene, user and deployment states require separate evidence.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Before polish, inspect three or four inexpensive front, side, top and oblique gray views for eight-leg attachment, female proportions, pair-III shortness, pedicel visibility and leg negative space.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: Palette-only, static original geometry; opaque, nonmetallic restrained earth colors; no imported imagery or textures.

shape_gate.en: An oval abdomen and compact forebody surrounded by long bristled legs, with the much shorter third pair retained.
shape_gate.zh: 椭圆腹部与紧凑头胸部四周伸长多毛足，保留显著短小的第三足。

scientific_limits.en: The compressed female fossil constrains selected outlines and lengths, not body depth, color, eyes, life pose or full soft anatomy. Missing distal leg-IV parts and short palps are reconstructed. Fine plumose setae are simplified. Relationships and web architecture remain uncertain; no golden silk or modern Nephila identity is implied. The male is comparative evidence, not a source of female palpal anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 雌性压扁化石约束部分轮廓与长度，不能确定体厚、颜色、眼部、活体姿态或完整软组织。第四足缺失远端及较短触肢属复原估计；细小羽状刚毛予以简化。亲缘关系及网结构仍有不确定性，不暗示金色蛛丝或现生 Nephila 身份；雄性仅作比较，不移植其触肢到雌性。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original low-poly adult female reconstruction of Mongolarachne jurassica, informed by holotype CNU-ARA-NN2010008 and the 2013 revision. An interpretive living form, not a fossil cast, exact life appearance, or resolved phylogenetic claim.
shape_requirements: Two main body regions with a visible narrow pedicel: compact forebody and larger non-spherical oval abdomen, widest toward its front and tapering rearward.
Exactly eight walking legs, in four bilateral pairs attached to the cephalothorax, plus two clearly shorter female palps. No leg originates on the abdomen.

Leg length order I > II > IV > III. The third pair is conspicuously shortest and below half the first-pair centerline length. Preserve long slender articulated legs and open negative spaces, not a tarantula-like heavy outline.

Retain visible segment changes and distal tibial bristle gaiters on every leg pair, including III. Gaiters are sparse original tapered tufts, not solid furry sleeves; finer setal microstructure is not claimed.
Small paired chelicerae tuck below the anterior forebody; do not add giant projecting fangs, crustacean claws, antennae, a tail or an abdominal sting.
Use understated anterior cephalic relief without claiming a fossil-derived eye arrangement. Do not add conspicuous invented eye dots.
Female palps must not copy the extremely elongated adult male palps. Do not add a web, golden silk, prey, habitat, slab, labels or display plinth to the exported asset.

taxon_scope.excluded_reference: Mongolarachne chaoyangensis, the altered crayfish identified in 2019
taxon_scope.taxonomic_basis: 2013 recombination; 2011 name Nephila jurassica retained only as historical reference

website_view_plan.reason: Use the standard three-quarter structural view for this thin-legged asset. No verified website renderer/camera contract is supplied at preparation; website derivations belong to later integration.
